evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifts monotonically upward during growth (2.90→3.22 Torr, k=20→25) versus a stable ~2.94 Torr throughout ramp
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C at setpoint with plausible heater power ~46%
o2_exhaust not installed, so atmosphere/air ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: Exhaust O2 (not installed) to distinguish an air leak from downstream restriction; alternatively a flow-step or pump-valve response test to see whether pressure tracks flow (blockage) or keeps climbing independently (leak).
